mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the venous valves was most worthwhile: the planned picture connects muscle compression, forward flow and prevention of backflow in one construction.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the thin-walled veins was the least distinctive passage: the picture plan shows their shape and lining but gives little explanation on its own.

surprise.text: The venous-return picture added a useful connection between contracting limb muscle and blood movement toward the heart.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless: each built or connected a vessel component. However, the distribution-bed picture introduces arterioles without explaining the term.

continue.text: I would be interested in continuing to see how this route connects to the heart and blood, because the vessel constructions made their different roles reasonably clear. That is a personal judgment, not evidence of student comprehension or enjoyment.
